[EVENT] User is considering camping instead of staying in a hotel near Mount Rushmore.

[ASSISTANT] The assistant provided details about amenities and activities at Mount Rushmore National Memorial KOA, including a pool, playground, and shuttle service to Mount Rushmore.  
[ASSISTANT] The assistant confirmed that the shuttle service to Mount Rushmore is free for KOA guests and runs every 30 minutes.  
[EVENT] User decided to go with the deluxe cabin rental at Mount Rushmore National Memorial KOA.  
[ASSISTANT] The assistant provided information about the shuttle service schedule and tips for using it.  
[EVENT] User is thinking about food options near Mount Rushmore.
